Status page

Status page not set up

An administrator creates the status page in the team's Cloudflare account from a laptop, with mmhotline status-page set-up, then adds the status_page section to the settings file and applies the settings.

Where status page settings are set

Set in /etc/mmhotline/mmhotline_settings.yml, in status_page. An administrator edits the settings file with sudoedit, then runs sudo mmhotline settings apply.

Times are New York time (America/New_York), the team's time zone.
